questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given equation.

11 * 4 * 3 * 3 * 7 * 8

Select the set of numbers from the given options, which is similar to the given set.

(17, 39, 11)
questions.solution:
The Logic here is as follows:

**(2ⁿd number - 1st number) ÷ 2 = 3rd number**

**In **(17, 39, 11)

**(2ⁿd number - 1st number) ÷ 2**

= (39 - 17) ÷ 2

= 22 ÷ 2

= 11 **= 3rd Number**

Now check the all options,

**Option (1) **(13, 47, 19)

**(2ⁿd number - 1st number) ÷ 2**

= (47 - 13) ÷ 2

= 34 ÷ 2

= 17 ≠** 3rd Number**

**Option (2) **(11, 35, 14)

**(2ⁿd number - 1st number) ÷ 2**

= (35 - 11) ÷ 2

= 24 ÷ 2

= 12 ≠** 3rd Number**

**Option (3) (18, 44, 13)**

**(2ⁿd number - 1st number) ÷ 2**

**= (44 - 18) ÷ 2**

**= 26 ÷ 2**

**= 13 = 3rd Number**

**Option (4) **(15, 27, 7)

**(2ⁿd number - 1st number) ÷ 2**

= (27 - 15) ÷ 2

= 12 ÷ 2

= 6 ≠** 3rd Number**

Hence, the correct answer is **"****(18, 44, 13)****".**

questions.question:
Arrange the following in a logical and meaningful order.

I. Kamet

II. Kanchenjunga

III. Nanda Devi

IV. Saltoro Kangri
questions.solution:
**This mountain ranges are arranged according to their location from North to South:-**

__**Key Points:**__

IV. Saltoro Kangri → ​It is located near the Siachen region, Northwest India. 

I. Kamet → It is the mountain peak of the Himalayas in Uttarakhand, northern India after Nanda Devi.

III. Nanda Devi → It is the mountain peak of the Himalayas in Uttarakhand, northern India.

II. Kanchenjunga → ​It is located Nepali Kumbhkaran Lungur, East india. 

__**Additional Information**__

 
• **Nanda Devi (7816 metres):**

 
 
• It is a part of Himalayan mountain ranges (Garhwal).
 
• This is the highest peak located entirely within India.
 
• The Nanda Devi National Prak, located in vicinity to the peak, consists of the best high altitude flora and fauna.
 
 
 
• **Kamet (7,756 metres):**
 
 
• **​**Kamet, mountain peak of the Himalayas in **Uttarakhand state**, northern India, **near the border with the Tibet Autonomous Region of China**.
 
• It is part of the **Zaskar range**.
 
 
 
• **Saltoro Kangri (7742 meters):**
 
 
• **​**It is located **near the Siachen Region**.
 
• The Saltoro Kangri is ranked the** 31st highest independent peak in the world**.
 
• It **lies in Saltoro range** (a part of **Karakoram Mountain range**)
 
 
 
• **Kanchenjunga (****8,586 metres****):**
 
 
• **​**It is located in Nepali **Kumbhkaran Lungur**.
 
• The **Kanchenjunga** is ranked the world’s third-highest mountain.
 
• It is a part of the Great Himalaya Range.
 
 

Hence, The correct logical arrangement is “IV, l, III, II”

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

17 × 3 ÷ 6 − 2 + 7 = 55
questions.solution:
According to the BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

**Option 1 :** - and ×

Given:

17 × 3 ÷ 6 − 2 + 7 = 55

After interchange the signs;

17 - 3 ÷ 6 × 2 + 7 = 55

By BODMAS rule

17 – 0.5 × 2 + 7 = 55

17 – 1 + 7 = 55

24 – 1 = 55

23 = 55** (LHS ≠ RHS)**

**Option 2 : **÷ and -

**Given:**

**17 × 3 ÷ 6 − 2 + 7 = 55**

**After interchange the signs;**

**17 × 3 - 6 ÷ 2 + 7 = 55**

**By BODMAS rule**

**17 × 3 - 3 + 7 = 55**

**51 - 3 + 7 = 55**

**58 - 3 = 55**

**55 = 55**** (LHS = RHS)**

**Option 3 :** ÷ and ×

Given:

17 × 3 ÷ 6 − 2 + 7 = 55

After interchange the signs;

17 ÷ 3 × 6 − 2 + 7 = 55

By BODMAS rule

5.67 × 6 − 2 + 7 = 55

34 − 2 + 7 = 55

41 − 2 = 55

39 = 55** (LHS ≠ RHS)**

**Option 4 :** + and ×

Given:

17 × 3 ÷ 6 − 2 + 7 = 55

After interchange the signs;

17 + 3 ÷ 6 − 2 × 7 = 55

By BODMAS rule

17 + 3 ÷ 6 − 2 × 7 = 55

17 + 0.5 − 2 × 7 = 55

17 + 0.5 − 14 = 55

17.5 − 14 = 55

3.5 = 55** (LHS ≠ RHS)**

Hence, the answer is **“****÷ and -”.**
